newsitem.title: UK: Dinasours no trouble to DHL.
newsitem.headline: Dinasours no trouble to DHL.

text.p: DHL Worldwide Express said it has safely delivered Gobi desert dinasours for an exhibition to be held at the Natural History Museum.in London.
DHL said the transporting of the dinasours from Mongolia to London proved challenging, as the prehistoric monsters weighing 126 kg, were too large to be easily handled and had to come in containers.
Within 24 hours of contacting its Mongolian office, DHL said the dinosaurs were flying to London where they are now on show. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
